title: Geographic Differential Discontinuation and Leveling Reorg Collision
question: Derek Huang asks his HRBP what his compensation will be after the upcoming changes. Based on all available information as of mid-March 2026, what is the most accurate answer?

contributor.name: Jasmine Torres
contributor.title: Senior Total Rewards Analyst
contributor.domain_expertise: Compensation band management, geo-differential policy, job leveling frameworks, market adjustments

choices: His base increases to $269K — removing the -8% geo-differential from his current $248K effectively restores the pre-differential amount of $269K ($248K / 0.92).
His base stays at $248K — the geo-differential elimination means his effective ceiling rises from $271K to $295K, but his current pay doesn't change since he's already within band.
His base should increase to at least $270K — the leveling reorg collapses L6/L7 EM into Senior EM with a $270K floor, requiring a market adjustment regardless of sequencing.

It cannot be determined yet — the geo elimination and leveling reorg interact, and the sequencing decision (which change lands first) has not been finalized, as evidenced by the empty meeting notes and pending comp committee approval.
